processes:task-eo-build-intake-8rb6w4.plain_language_name: Receive the Installed Assets for Commissioning
processes:task-eo-build-intake-8rb6w4.plain_language_description: Commissioning opens when the installed assets are handed over as the kit to be brought to operational readiness. The intake custodian accepts them, registers them with audit identifiers, and starts the commissioning from a recorded baseline.
processes:task-eo-build-intake-8rb6w4.business_purpose: It exists so commissioning runs over a registered set of installed assets rather than over whatever is half-placed.
processes:task-eo-build-intake-8rb6w4.practical_context: It opens when the installed assets are presented for commissioning, with the activity owner alerted, and it closes with the intake registered and the later steps free to run.

worked_example.narrative: An intake custodian registers the installed assets as the commissioning baseline, with audit references, and opens the readiness work.

processes:task-eo-build-transform-fypdss.plain_language_name: Bring the Installed Assets to Operational Readiness
processes:task-eo-build-transform-fypdss.plain_language_description: With the set verified, the processing custodian does the commissioning itself: each installed asset is tested and brought to readiness against the architecture's acceptance criteria, and the commissioned assets are set down in the form the activity defines. Working papers are preserved for audit.
processes:task-eo-build-transform-fypdss.business_purpose: It exists because installed is not the same as usable - commissioning is the proof that an asset actually works as bought.
processes:task-eo-build-transform-fypdss.practical_context: It starts once checking is complete and the verified set is ready to be commissioned, and it ends with the commissioned assets produced and the working papers kept.

worked_example.narrative: A processing custodian in product management tests each installed asset to the acceptance criteria and records the commissioned set, keeping the working papers.

processes:task-eo-build-verify-vwgrxx.plain_language_name: Check the Installed Assets Before Commissioning Them
processes:task-eo-build-verify-vwgrxx.plain_language_description: Before any asset is commissioned, the verification custodian checks the installed set against what commissioning requires - that every asset is in its environment and ready to be tested to the acceptance criteria. Defects are logged for rejection or repair before the commissioning begins.
processes:task-eo-build-verify-vwgrxx.business_purpose: It exists so no asset is called operational-ready before it is even properly in place.
processes:task-eo-build-verify-vwgrxx.practical_context: It runs once the intake is registered and the set can be compared with the activity's requirements, and it finishes with it verified or its defects logged for rejection or remediation.

worked_example.narrative: A verification custodian finds an asset installed outside its designated environment and logs the defect before commissioning begins.

processes:task-eo-build-record-yugy2m.plain_language_name: File the Technology Installation Audit Record
processes:task-eo-build-record-yugy2m.plain_language_description: At the close the records custodian preserves the installation trail at its required retention tier and sets the retrieval handles for it. Which assets went where, per which topology, stays readable whenever an installed position is questioned.
processes:task-eo-build-record-yugy2m.business_purpose: It exists so the placing of each asset can be evidenced whenever its position is questioned.
processes:task-eo-build-record-yugy2m.practical_context: It starts once the confirmation has been issued and retention may begin under the activity's evidence requirements, and it ends with the audit record preserved at its tier and retrieval handles standing.

worked_example.narrative: A records custodian files the installation trail at its retention tier and sets the retrieval handles an infrastructure review would consult.

processes:task-eo-build-confirm-ks6bup.plain_language_description: When the assets stand installed, the confirmation custodian reconciles them against the outcome the activity set out to reach and issues the confirmation. The commissioning step that follows learns the assets are in place and ready to be brought to readiness.
processes:task-eo-build-confirm-ks6bup.business_purpose: It exists so commissioning proceeds only over assets confirmed as installed.
processes:task-eo-build-confirm-ks6bup.practical_context: It begins once preparation is complete and the installed assets await their consumers, and it closes with the confirmation issued, consumers told, and the result reconciled to the activity's promise.

worked_example.narrative: A confirmation custodian reconciles the installed assets against the activity's intended outcome and issues the confirmation the commissioning step needs.
